title: Systematic Localization of Late-Time Cosmological Signals in Modified Gravity: CMB Survival, the Lensing Barrier, and a Growth-Sector Sign Constraint
abstract: Five-phase localization study of where late-time modified-gravity signals can reside, using Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) as a case study. The background gate collapses (alpha consistent with zero) under joint CMB+BAO+SNe, pure growth modification (mu<1 with Sigma=1) is blocked by CMB lensing, and a narrow perturbation-sector slip window survives Planck with mu≈0.94 and Sigma≈1.05. The surviving valley is degenerate with the Planck AL anomaly, but fσ8 growth data independently favor mu<1, providing a growth-sector sign constraint.
